decisions.reason: It fits the firm's drainage-system know-how and stayed prominent through 2019, so with moderate carrying costs the option value still outweighs the case for withdrawal.
A floor-level shower drainage system is directly in the firm's strategic direction and its stronger 2019 presentation suggests positive resolution of uncertainty rather than failure.
Its move from a dedicated page to a mere mention points to weaker traction, and after several years the option looks less attractive relative to other shower-drainage projects.
Although never heavily promoted, an integrated-slope shower element closely complements the firm's installation-focused bathroom systems and is cheap to keep as part of a broader solution set.
The product received especially strong launch and homepage visibility, indicating good promise in a safety-critical drainage niche that suits the firm's engineering strengths.
The air-admittance valve appears more peripheral to the firm's core shower and drainage-system trajectory and only weakly evidenced on the website, so resources are better redeployed.
